INSERT INTO tb_board_post ( tenant_id, board_type_code, title, category_code, contents, contents_html, contents_json, contents_text, writer_id, writer_name, last_modified_by, last_modified_by_name, view_count, is_pinned, login_popup_yn, popup_end_date, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{boardTypeCode}, #{title}, #{noticeGubunCode}, #{contents}, #{contentsHtml}, CAST(#{contentsJson} AS json), #{contentsText}, #{writerId}, #{writerName}, #{lastModifiedBy}, #{lastModifiedByName}, 0, #{isPinned}, #{loginPopupYn}, CAST(#{popupEndDate} AS date), 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING post_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_board_post SET title = #{title}, category_code = #{noticeGubunCode}, contents = #{contents}, contents_html = #{contentsHtml}, contents_json = CAST(#{contentsJson} AS json), contents_text = #{contentsText}, writer_name = #{writerName}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_by_name = #{lastModifiedByName}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, login_popup_yn = #{loginPopupYn}, popup_end_date = CAST(#{popupEndDate} AS date), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND board_type_code = #{boardTypeCode} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT bf.file_id AS board_file_id, bf.owner_id AS post_id, bf.file_name, bf.file_path, bf.object_key, bf.bucket_name, bf.storage_provider, bf.file_size, bf.mime_type, bf.checksum_sha256, bf.content_type, bf.file_usage_type, bf.deleted_yn, bf.uploaded_by, bf.created_at, bf.updated_at FROM tb_common_file bf WHERE bf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND bf.owner_type = 'NOTICE' AND bf.owner_id = #{postId} AND bf.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY bf.created_at DESC

SELECT bf.file_id AS board_file_id, bf.owner_id AS post_id, bf.file_name, bf.file_path, bf.object_key, bf.bucket_name, bf.storage_provider, bf.file_size, bf.mime_type, bf.checksum_sha256, bf.content_type, bf.file_usage_type, bf.deleted_yn, bf.uploaded_by, bf.created_at, bf.updated_at FROM tb_common_file bf WHERE bf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND bf.file_id = #{boardFileId} AND bf.owner_type = 'NOTICE' AND bf.deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_common_file ( tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, content_type, file_usage_type, deleted_yn, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, 'NOTICE', #{postId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{objectKey}, #{bucketName}, #{storageProvider}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{checksumSha256}, #{contentType}, #{fileUsageType}, #{deletedYn}, #{uploadedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING file_id
